cases.name: Kristen Marie Jorge
cases.narrative:
He entered the home and waited. Kristen came home from school early, and unexpectedly. Smith stabbed her to death and then sexually assaulted her (after her death). Her mother discovered Kristen in a bedroom wrapped in a comforter on the floor between the bed and the wall. She had multiple lacerations to the neck, shoulder, back, and hand. 

In his statement to Det. Bucci he admitted stabbing Kristen and having intercourse with her after she was dead.   He told police that after he had entered Benard's apartment through the window, he “took possession of a knife” from the knife holder on the kitchen counter. When Kristen entered the apartment, he hid from her in her room under the bed. 

Then, after Kristen had left the apartment to take the dog out, defendant tried to leave the apartment but was surprised by Kristen, who had returned through the living room door “and told him that he had no right to be there and that she was going to call the police.” (VICTIM-BLAMING)

He then grabbed her and “dragged her [from the living room] to her [bed]room [where he] immediately began cutting and stabbing her” with the knife he had secured when he had first entered through the kitchen window. The defendant told Det. Bucci that “he stabbed [Kristen] approximately fifteen times” and, after he thought she was dead, “had sex with her.”  To accomplish the rape, defendant pulled down her pants and underwear and then “stimulate[d him]self to get an erection” prior to raping her.
